entries.title: Numbers 2:1
segments: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 2:2
segments: The children of Israel shall encamp every one by his standard, with the ensign of their father's house; round about the tent of meeting, afar off, opposite to it shall they encamp.

entries.title: Numbers 2:3
segments: ¶And [for] those encamping eastward toward the sun-rising [there shall be] the standard of the camp of Judah according to their hosts; and the prince of the sons of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab;

entries.title: Numbers 2:4
segments: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:5
segments: And those that encamp next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar; and the prince of the sons of Issachar shall be Nethaneel the son of Zuar;

entries.title: Numbers 2:6
segments: and his host, even those that were numbered thereof, fifty-four thousand four hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:7
segments: [With them shall be] the tribe of Zebulun; and the prince of the sons of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon;

entries.title: Numbers 2:8
segments: and his host, even those that were numbered thereof, fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:9
segments: All that were numbered of the camp of Judah were a hundred and eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their hosts. They shall set forth first.

entries.title: Numbers 2:10
segments: The standard of the camp of Reuben shall be southward according to their hosts; and the prince of the sons of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur;

entries.title: Numbers 2:11
segments: and his host, even those that were numbered thereof, forty-six thousand five hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:12
segments: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Simeon; and the prince of the sons of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai;

entries.title: Numbers 2:13
segments: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:14
segments: And [with them shall be] the tribe of Gad; and the prince of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel;

entries.title: Numbers 2:15
segments: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.

entries.title: Numbers 2:16
segments: All that were numbered of the camp of Reuben were a hundred and fifty-one thousand four hundred and fifty, according to their hosts. And they shall set forth second.

entries.title: Numbers 2:17
segments: And the tent of meeting shall set forth, the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camps; as they encamp, so shall they set forth, every man in his place, according to their standards.

entries.title: Numbers 2:18
segments: The standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their hosts shall be westward; and the prince of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud;

entries.title: Numbers 2:19
segments: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, forty thousand five hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:20
segments: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh; and the prince of the sons of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur;

entries.title: Numbers 2:21
segments: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, thirty-two thousand two hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:22
segments: And [with them shall be] the tribe of Benjamin; and the prince of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni;

entries.title: Numbers 2:23
segments: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, thirty-five thousand four hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:24
segments: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were a hundred and eight thousand one hundred, according to their hosts. And they shall set forth third.

entries.title: Numbers 2:25
segments: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be northward according to their hosts; and the prince of the sons of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai;

entries.title: Numbers 2:26
segments: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:27
segments: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher; and the prince of the sons of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran;

entries.title: Numbers 2:28
segments: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, forty-one thousand five hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:29
segments: And [with them shall be] the tribe of Naphtali; and the prince of the sons of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan;

entries.title: Numbers 2:30
segments: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:31
segments: All that were numbered of the camp of Dan were a hundred and fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set forth last according to their standards.

entries.title: Numbers 2:32
segments: These are those that were numbered of the children of Israel, according to their fathers' houses: all those that were numbered of the camps, according to their hosts, were six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.

entries.title: Numbers 2:33
segments: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Numbers 2:34
segments: And the children of Israel did according to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses: so they encamped according to their standards, and so they journeyed, every one according to their families, according to their fathers' houses.
